purpose: Operator inspection of the package-derived Fleet Telemetry routing and subscription configuration snapshot, destination fan-out, orphan routing entries and per-category field evidence.
primaryGoal: Determine which catalogue fields are routed, subscribed or orphaned, and inspect their destinations, typed columns and signal_log dual writes without confusing configuration coverage with observed vehicle telemetry.

dataSources.name: Fleet Telemetry coverage snapshot

routeEvidence.detail: Nested /coverage GET registration; rate limited to 60 requests per minute. Router comments at 1539-1543 identify a DB-free embedded routing map and teslaconfig.Builder configuration source.

dataSources.policy: STALE_TIMES.SLOW; forwards TanStack Query AbortSignal; inherited retry/cache behavior was not independently inspected.
dataSources.normalization: Hook lines 43-46 default missing categories/orphans to [] and destinations to {}. No vehicle/date scope or measured SI quantity is introduced.
dataSources.sourceOwnership: Backend configuration snapshot, not runtime stream health. Handler implementation, effective authentication and actual response correctness were not exercised.

CoverageOperationalBrief.tsx lines 11-46: six count/percentage metrics from the same snapshot.
CoverageCategory.tsx lines 16-71: field filtering, destination counts and five-column field matrix.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Page category selection and CoverageCategory field selection repeat field/destination/column matching but differ for category-name matches. A category-only query keeps its card while its table says no fields match.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use one feature-owned matching policy that explicitly preserves category-name and per-field search semantics; retain both result counts and table value filters. No cross-page shared search abstraction is justified by this audit.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: The identical provenance is supplied to OperationalBrief and repeated immediately as a caption at line 71. The shared brief consumes provenance in its narrative/details rather than ignoring it.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Review deliberate summary-versus-detail placement and avoid redundant visible explanation without deleting the package-only provenance or drawer details.

sourceStrategy: Page lines 162-170: one-column destination/legend grid, with hero spanning two of three columns at xl.
Page lines 339-360: filter stacks below sm and becomes a row above sm.
Page lines 401-407: category masonry uses one column, two at 2xl and three at 3xl; shared implementation documents column-major order.
Badge wrappers on page lines 242 and 329 and category lines 79-88 preserve wrapping for destination/orphan identifiers.

issues.rule: MDC-023 / MDC-043 / preserve full mobile evidence
issues.detail: mobileColumns only includes field, destination and subscribed; column and also_signal_log are hidden below md. No mobilePresentation or expansion body is passed. DataTable lines 724-725 apply hidden md:table-cell and lines 1385-1396 require explicit presentation/expansion for alternate detail access.
issues.fix: Use the existing DataTable mobilePresentation/full-details contract or preserve all five columns with horizontal scrolling. Keep tableId, loaded matching-row export scope, all value filters, sorting and column preferences.

issues.detail: The Y axis reserves 148px plus left/right margins, independent of the allocated card width. At 320px this leaves limited bar/label room; clipping or usability is a risk, not a measured failure.
issues.fix: Verify long destination identifiers and complete chart-table alternatives at narrow widths; use existing chart sizing contracts rather than removing destinations or reducing data.

issues.detail: The category result caption updates with local search but has no explicit status/live-region semantics. PageContainer's query announcement does not describe local filter changes.
issues.fix: Give the localized category result count a polite status role using existing typography props; avoid duplicate announcements with table value-filter feedback.

states.initialLoading: Page line 129 guards firstLoad with isLoading && !data; chart uses ChartSkeleton at 177-179 and category band uses ListSkeleton at 367-373. Summary uses DataState initial status for metric loading at adapter line 62.
states.success: All six summary metrics, destination chart/text counts, static reading legend, optional orphan warning, filter and category tables use the same snapshot.
states.empty: Chart empty message at 184-185; category-empty message at 381-391; filtered-empty message at 392-399; per-category no-match at category lines 92-95.
states.fatalError: deriveDataState fatalError is used at page lines 94-95, chart line 177 and category lines 374-380. Explicit retry uses the existing refetch.
states.refreshError: Retained data remains visible because fatalError is null with data. Summary adapter lines 56-60 exposes retained status and refresh error; PageLayout retains query/source props.
states.staleOffline: DataState lines 244-250 classifies paused retained data as stale; summary status/freshness and shared notices receive the query. Offline presentation, paused initial load and recovery were not exercised.
states.disabled: Refresh is disabled while fetching and has background loading state at page lines 145-147.
states.partialUnknown: Single configured source; no explicit partial source is supplied. Absent query data yields null summary metrics; resolved empty catalogue retains documented 0% convention. Hook normalizes missing collections, so malformed response versus legitimate empty cannot be distinguished here.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-045 / unknown is not zero
issues.detail: category.total_fields ?? 0 displays a missing runtime field as a measured zero even though its TypeScript contract requires a number. This is defensive malformed-payload behavior, not proof that the backend currently omits it.
issues.fix: Use an existing unknown placeholder for absent totals without changing valid zero values or the field-count calculations; preserve source total rather than silently replacing it with a new calculation.

visualIssues.detail: One count series assigns a different chartTokens.series hue by destination rank. The shared palette at tokens.ts:401 has eight saturated hues, so destinations can form a rainbow and change color when ranking changes. This is a source-level decoration concern, not a screenshot finding.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer a restrained existing semantic chart color for this single series; preserve count ordering, all bars, labels, legend text and user chart/theme preferences. Do not invent a palette or globally reset saved color choices.

visualIssues.detail: Tooltip cursor uses literal white rgba(255,255,255,0.04), not a theme-aware surface token. It is a low-opacity hover overlay, not opaque pure-white body text; effective contrast or visual noise was not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Use the current neutral chart/surface treatment for hover without changing tooltip content or counts.

architectureIssues.detail: The live query always mounts before testHookOverride is selected at line 91. An override replaces presentation but does not disable the live query subscription/request. Existing behavior is source-confirmed; a network request was not observed.
architectureIssues.fix: If retaining this testing seam, isolate query orchestration from the injected presentation result using the existing architecture and unchanged production key, cancellation and policy. Do not assume the override guarantees a network-free test.

priority.rationale: Preserve full mobile field evidence and reconcile category search before presentation polish. No runtime outage, security defect or mounted accessibility acceptance was established.

competingImplementations.detail: The page already uses existing layout, OperationalBrief, DataTable, chart frame, source-state and typography owners. Duplicate local search logic is reported above, not evidence for a new shared library. Existing DataTable props can address the mobile gap without shared source edits.
competingImplementations.scopeLimit: Only direct page-specific dependencies were inspected; no app-wide duplicate-component or consumer inventory was attempted.

preservation.sectionCountingMethod: Five numbered functional bands in current page source; primary bento contains two separate cards. Category card count is response-dependent.

sections.name: Coverage summary
sections.preserve: Six raw-derived metrics, precision, descriptions, denominator, source status, freshness, provenance and review-details drawer.

sections.name: Destination breakdown and reading legend
sections.preserve: All destination bars and counts, responsive height, text fallback, three explanatory legend items, and dual-write fan-out explanation.

sections.name: Orphan-fields drift warning
sections.preserve: Conditional presence when orphan_fields is nonempty, every orphan identifier and complete deployment-drift explanation. Absence is not an omitted feature.

sections.name: Filter toolbar and category result count
sections.preserve: Controlled case-insensitive trimmed search, category/field/destination/column matching and shown/total count.

sections.name: Per-category evidence detail
sections.preserve: Category title, source total, sorted destination counts and all field/destination/column/dual-write/subscribed cells; loading/error/empty/no-match branches.

actions: Refresh and every fatal-error Retry invoke the original refetch; fetching disables Refresh.
Local text search and clearing it restore original categories; per-table value filters remain independent.
Existing DataTable sorting for field/destination/column/subscribed, value filters, column persistence/resizing/reordering and matching-loaded-row CSV/JSON exports remain owned by DataTable.
Stable table IDs coverage:fields:${category.category}, stable row keys ${category.category}:${row.field}, and existing data-testid identities must survive.
OperationalBrief Review details opens existing shared metric/narrative drawer and retains all source explanations.
Do not add subscribe, configuration-write, vehicle/date selectors, chart fullscreen or chart export actions: these are not page capabilities in this source.
dataBehavior: One package configuration snapshot; no per-vehicle last-payload timestamp or fields-seen-in-range claim.
Destination totals can exceed unique routed-field count because dual writes include both primary destination and signal_log.
Counts use locale formatting; subscription percentage uses saved precision. Unknown snapshot is null, resolved empty catalogue retains documented zero-percent convention.
Unfiltered summary and destination/orphan evidence remain global to the snapshot when category/field search changes.
Keep source arrays/order, derived descending destination counts, nullable column dash, dual-write dash and subscribed yes/no meanings.
Retained successful snapshot stays mounted during background fetch/error/paused states; fatal failures alone replace source content.
No raw physical SI value is converted or modified; no new wire/cache shape, backend endpoint or query policy is authorized.

evidenceLimits.routeMount: Assigned route recorded exactly; frontend routing implementation and actual mounted reachability were not inspected.
evidenceLimits.backend: Only matching router block/comments read; handler/runtime configuration/authentication and actual payloads unverified.
